mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous three months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous three months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases consistently but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) over the previous three months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 0.5% in 3 months but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous three months signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous six months signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and GDPC1 increases > 1% in 6 months
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and GDPC1 increases > 1% in 6 months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the previous three months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200k in 3 months but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous six months signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases consistently but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances.
